features.title: Accept admitted continued-form answers as direct goal authority
features.summary: The native goal-tool fork recognizes only an answered root-turn reply whose call id the user-question projection settled with a valid answer batch.
failureModes: Skipped, failed, queued, stale, unmatched, or malformed question replies do not grant authority.
Subagents, closed turns, and missing user-question projection state remain unauthorized.

verification.testName: accepts only an answered reply matched to a settled call

verification.reason: The fork replaces a Host Loader row and renders no UI; the scratch Host boot check verifies the replacement bundle loads.
